# Romeo Alpha Maritime

> Romeo Alpha Maritime Consultants and Logistics International Ltd is a maritime services company headquartered in Port Harcourt, Nigeria. It provides ship chartering, marine security escort, offshore oil & gas support, maritime transportation, vessel repair, and vessel/scrap sales, with core expertise in the Gulf of Guinea and West African waters and coverage of international shipping routes.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Romeo Alpha Maritime Consultants and Logistics International Ltd
- Short name: Romeo Alpha Maritime
- Headquarters: No. 58 Circular Road, Alcon Road, Woji, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 806 618 4330, +234 805 576 9660
- Email: info@romeoalphamaritime.com
- Registration: Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) RC 9257242; SCUML (EFCC) SC261080
- Service area: Gulf of Guinea, West Africa, and international shipping lanes connecting Africa, Europe and the Americas
- Operations: 24/7 operations support

## Services
- [Vessel Chartering & Ship Management](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/charter): finding the right vessel in the right location at the right time, with crew supply, bunkering and vessel inspections.
- [Marine Security Escort](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/security): armed escort vessels, asset protection and risk assessments for transit through high-risk zones.
- [Offshore Oil & Gas Support](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/offshore): platform and oil rig support, oilfield logistics, supply vessels, crew transfers, anchor handling and towing.
- [Maritime Transportation & Shipping](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/service/maritime): marine transportation and shipping logistics for dry and liquid cargo.
- [Marketplace](https://romeoalphamaritime.com/marketplace): vessels and marine equipment for sale or hire, scrap vessel sales, and repair services.

## Frequently asked questions
- What services does Romeo Alpha offer? Vessel chartering, offshore support, marine security escort, ship brokerage, cargo logistics, fleet management, and oil & gas offshore operations across coastal and international waters.
- Where do you operate? Globally, with primary coverage of West African waters, the Gulf of Guinea, the Mediterranean, and international routes connecting Africa, Europe and the Americas.
- How do I request a quote? Use the "Get Quotes" button on the website, email info@romeoalphamaritime.com, or call the operations line. The team typically responds within 24 hours.
- What vessels are available? Offshore support vessels (OSVs), anchor handling tugs (AHTS), platform supply vessels (PSVs), crew boats, tugboats and security escort vessels.
- Is support available 24/7? Yes, the operations centre monitors active vessels around the clock.
- How can I partner with Romeo Alpha? Contact the business development team via https://romeoalphamaritime.com/contact.
